meta.ref: main (zip of the default branch, 28 Oct 2026; no commit sha in the archive)
meta.restyled: Calm palette and Plus Jakarta Sans applied in the design system on 29 Oct 2026; not yet in the repository.

tokens.name: color-mist
tokens.usage: Calm palette. The greyish-white page; reach for it through `bg-page`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Calm palette. Cards, inputs, the active nav pill; reach for it through `bg-surface`. White cards on mist always carry `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: color-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Calm palette. The one feature card per screen, the BTO result card, hover tints. Fill only; ink text on it 14.2:1, slate 5.1:1.

tokens.name: color-blush
tokens.usage: Calm palette. Soft pink fills: selected chips, the step pill, the resale card, badges, the avatar. Fill only; ink text on it 12.6:1.

tokens.name: color-pink
tokens.usage: Calm palette. The pink accent: resale in charts and the heatmap, the disc on primary buttons, lit windows. Fill only (ink on it 8.7:1, white fails).

tokens.name: color-pink-deep
tokens.usage: Calm palette. Small accents in flat scenes (a bike frame) and the dotted resale line on periwinkle. Fill or 4px+ marks only, never text.

tokens.name: color-berry
tokens.usage: Calm palette. The only pink for text or small marks (5.6:1 on white); 'level' in charts.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Calm palette. Text, primary buttons, illustrated people; reach for it through `text-primary` and `primary`.

tokens.name: color-slate
tokens.usage: Calm palette. Supporting text; reach for it through `text-secondary`.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body text and illustration details on `bg-page` (15.1:1), `bg-surface` (16.8:1) and `bg-feature` (14.2:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, labels, inactive nav on `bg-page` (5.4:1), `bg-surface` (6.0:1) and `bg-feature` (5.1:1).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders and decoration. 2.7:1 on white: never text the user must read.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and chip borders, dividers, table rules, the heatmap 'level' midpoint, unplayed timeline bars.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Faint dividers inside cards; the navbar line once scrolled.

tokens.name: surface-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled fields and buttons, chip hover, skeletons.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page and body background.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels, always with `shadow-sm`; inputs.

tokens.name: bg-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modals and popovers with `shadow-lg`.

tokens.name: bg-feature
tokens.usage: The single highlighted card on a screen (plan intro, estate scene, BTO result), with a 1px white edge.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary pill buttons, the active stepper border, progress and ring fills. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and active.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (16.8:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring with a 2px `bg-page` offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The pink accent fill: the disc inside primary buttons, progress bars, highlights. Never text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft pink fills: selected chips, step pills, badges.

tokens.name: data-bto
tokens.usage: BTO / path A in charts, the heatmap and the timeline (above the line).

tokens.name: data-resale
tokens.usage: Resale / path B in charts, the heatmap and the timeline. Only 1.9:1 against white, so resale marks must also differ by position (below the line), a pattern (dotted line) or a label – never pink alone.

tokens.name: data-level
tokens.usage: A tie or break-even year in charts.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and badges only. 5.0:1 on white; 4.3:1 on `success-fill`, so badge text there is 14px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge background, with `success` text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status and 'not yet verified' badges only (no longer a chart colour). 4.7:1 on white; 4.1:1 on `warning-fill`, so badge text there is 14px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Warning banner background, with `warning` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed validation, destructive actions. 6.0:1 on white, 5.0:1 on `danger-fill`.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Error banner background, with `danger` text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational banner text and icons.

tokens.name: info-fill
tokens.usage: Info banner background, with `info` text (5.1:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page questions and hero statements ('How are you feeling about your next home?'). 3rem (48px) from lg. `text-primary`.
styles.sample: How are you feeling about your next home?

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Result statements ('BTO pulls ahead of resale in 2034'). 2.25rem (36px) from lg.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card titles and form questions. 1.5rem (24px) from lg.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Section headings ('Recommended for you'). 1.25rem (20px) from lg.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy, max 75 characters a line (`.text-measure`). `text-primary` or `text-secondary`.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Secondary copy and dense UI; the smallest size outside captions and badges (14px).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels (above the field, 14px 500 in the mocks) and stepper steps. `text-primary`.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Money, percentages and number tables: Plus Jakarta Sans 500 with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (`.text-numeric`); big result figures at 24–34px with -0.02em tracking.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Heatmap cell gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Stepper gaps, small button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px. Button vertical padding, compare-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. Base unit (Bootstrap $spacer); alert padding, small button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 24px. Button horizontal padding, space under the hero statement.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 32px. Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 48px. Between page sections; heatmap cell height.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 64px. Largest section spacing.

tokens.name: container-max-width
tokens.usage: Container max width at xl and above; Bootstrap's 12-column grid below.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, heatmap cells, small icon buttons (14px in mocks).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels, alerts, result cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, the results 'player' card, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, nav pill, badge and the step pill.

shadow.note: Soft, cool shadows that lift white cards off the mist page; the only separation cards need.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Every white card, the active nav pill and icon buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The main form card and hover or focus-within on clickable cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The results player card and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge
tokens.usage: Floating pills that should feel pressable: the three navigation pills.
